title: Breaking the Computational Barrier: Provably Efficient Actor-Critic for Low-Rank MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2605.01242v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a fundamental framework for sequential decision-making, in which an agent learns an optimal policy through interactions with an unknown environment. In settings with function approximation, many existing RL algorithms achieve favorable sample complexity, but often rely on computationally intractable oracles. In this paper, we use supervised learning as a computational proxy to establish a clear hierarchy of commonly adopted RL oracles under low-rank Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). This hierarchy shows that policy evaluation is the most computationally efficient oracle, provided that supervised learning can be efficiently solved. Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel optimistic actor-critic algorithm that relies solely on a truncated policy evaluation oracle. translated_title: 突破计算障碍：低秩MDP中可证明高效的Actor-Critic算法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）是序贯决策的基本框架，其中智能体通过与未知环境的交互来学习最优策略。在函数逼近的设置下，许多现有的RL算法获得了良好的样本复杂度，但往往依赖于计算上难以处理的预言机。在本文中，我们使用监督学习作为计算代理，在低秩马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）下建立了常用RL预言机的清晰层级结构。该层级结构表明，只要监督学习能够被高效求解，策略评估就是计算上最高效的预言机。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的乐观Actor-Critic算法，该算法仅依赖于截断策略评估预言机。我们证明该算法在低秩MDP上的样本复杂度优于现有保证，同时避免了计算上难以处理的oracle。
tldr: 本文提出了一种仅依赖截断策略评估预言机的乐观Actor-Critic算法，通过建立RL预言机的计算复杂度层级，首次在低秩MDP中实现了无需计算上难解预言机的可证明高效算法，样本复杂度优于现有结果。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a computational hierarchy of RL oracles under low-rank MDPs and proposes a novel optimistic actor-critic algorithm relying solely on a truncated policy evaluation oracle, achieving provably better sample complexity while breaking the computational barrier.
